description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dehipagoda, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320241
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the determination of title to specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcels including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
